name: JointInterestBillingDisputeDesk
tagline: Review operator JIB statements, catch over-billing and win back credits.
description: Joint Interest Billing review and dispute desk for non-operated oil & gas partners. Automatic WI, COPAS overhead, AFE overrun, duplicate, prior-period and non-consent checks; exceptions and disputes with the operator; response and audit-window tracking; partner correspondence; pay statements net of withheld amounts.
features: Automatic JIB checks with quantified over-billing
Status workflow with required fields and allowed transitions
Response due and audit window countdowns
Bulk accept / exception / dispute / assign / delete with undo
